metadata.title: Branding and Technology Projects | Skave
metadata.description: Explore Skave’s work in brand development, online experiences, and digital products. Strategy, design, and technology for digital businesses.

items.question: What types of projects do you develop?
items.answer: We work across three main areas: brand positioning, digital experiences, and digital products. This ranges from strategy and verbal and visual identity to websites, platforms, applications, prototypes, and design systems.

items.question: Is there a minimum investment required to work with Skave?
items.answer: The investment varies according to the scope, complexity, and stage of each business. After an initial conversation, we prepare a proposal aligned with the project's goals and needs.

items.question: How long does a project with Skave usually take?
items.answer: The timeline depends on the scope and complexity of the solution. More focused projects may take a few weeks, while broader initiatives are organized into stages over several months.

items.question: Do you build projects from scratch or also improve existing solutions?
items.answer: We do both. We can create a brand, experience, or product from the ground up, as well as assess and evolve an existing solution through research, benchmarking, audits, and experience and interface improvements.

items.question: Can Skave work exclusively on Branding or exclusively on Tech?
items.answer: Yes. Branding and Tech can be engaged independently or together. The working structure is defined according to the challenge and the capabilities the project actually requires.

items.question: How do you define the ideal solution for each project?
items.answer: We begin by understanding the business, its context, its users, and its goals. From this assessment, we combine strategy, design, and technology in the right measure to build a relevant and viable solution.

items.question: Does the work end at delivery, or do you also support the project's evolution?
items.answer: We can provide both one-off deliveries and ongoing support. After launch, we can assist with analysis, improvements, and new stages of evolution according to the needs of the business.

metadata.title: Privacy Notice | Skave
metadata.description: Learn how Skave collects, uses, shares, and protects personal data submitted through this website.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Notice
privacyPage.intro: This notice explains how Skave processes personal data from people who visit our website, contact us, or request information about our services.

sections.title: 1. Who processes your data
paragraphs: Skave is responsible for decisions regarding the processing of personal data described in this notice. Privacy questions and requests can be sent to contato@skave.co.

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
paragraphs: When you use our contact form, we may collect your name, email address, phone number, company information, expected investment range, referral source, and any information you freely include in your message.
We may also receive technical data required for the operation and security of the website, such as IP address, request date and time, browser type, and error logs.

sections.title: 3. How we use data
paragraphs: We use the data to review your request, respond to you, understand project needs, prepare proposals, and take preliminary steps related to a potential agreement.
We may also process information strictly necessary to protect the website, prevent abuse, comply with legal obligations, and exercise rights in administrative or judicial proceedings.

sections.title: 4. Legal bases
paragraphs: Depending on the purpose, processing may be based on taking preliminary steps related to an agreement at your request, compliance with a legal or regulatory obligation, the regular exercise of rights, or Skave's legitimate interests, always after assessing the data subject's rights and expectations.
If a specific purpose depends on consent, it will be requested separately and may be withdrawn through the channels listed in this notice.

sections.title: 5. Sharing and service providers
paragraphs: Data may be processed by providers required to operate the website and respond to your request, such as hosting, workflow automation — including Make —, email, and internal management services.

These providers act under our instructions and must use the data only for the contracted purposes. We may also share information when required by law, ordered by a competent authority, or necessary to protect the rights of Skave or third parties.

sections.title: 6. International transfers
paragraphs: Some technology providers may store or process data outside Brazil. In such cases, we seek to use providers and mechanisms compatible with the LGPD and appropriate protection measures.

sections.title: 7. Retention and deletion
paragraphs: We retain data only for as long as necessary to respond to the request, develop the business relationship, comply with legal obligations, and safeguard the exercise of rights. Data is then deleted or anonymized unless retention is permitted or required by law.

sections.title: 8. Security
paragraphs: We adopt technical and administrative measures proportionate to the risks to protect data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration, disclosure, or improper destruction. No digital environment is entirely risk-free, but we review our practices and providers to reduce these possibilities.

sections.title: 9. Your rights
paragraphs: Under the LGPD, you may request confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymization, blocking or deletion of inadequate or excessive data, portability where applicable, information about sharing, and review of automated decisions.

You may also object to processing or withdraw previously given consent when applicable. To exercise your rights, email contato@skave.co. We may request information to verify your identity and protect your data.

sections.title: 10. Cookies and similar technologies
paragraphs: The website may use technical resources strictly necessary for operation, security, and saving user preferences. If optional analytics, advertising, or tracking tools are added, this notice will be updated and, where required, a choice mechanism will be offered before activation.

sections.title: 11. Changes to this notice
paragraphs: This notice may be updated to reflect changes to the website, providers, or processing practices. The current version and its revision date will remain available on this page.
